chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Buck's singing and scat; where scat came from
summary: Buck was no strong singer but harmonized and scatted with Bubbles in Rhythm for Sale; he thinks Louis Armstrong may have been the first scatter he heard.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: You can't hear him?
Not terribly strong.
Well, he can't be strong, he's not a singer. He can't come out as strong as mine. I'm a singer. You heard his scat on that.
Was he a good scat singer.

Yeah, he's all right scatting. Nobody sang over him, we used to sing in harmony to each other. We didn't try to outsing each other, see who could sing the best or loudest. No, it wasn't that. We'd scat on the end of a song and of a number and then we'd sing the harmony if we were doing a number and he would do the harmony with me, okay,

he come out all right, come out in 40 years, somebody must have found out in 40 years it was right, wasn't it. He sang loud enough, not too loud and loud enough for 40 years, man, how could he be so wrong?
Did you scat, too?
Yeah.
Can you give me a little sample of that, how your scatting went?

Oh, those were the days. Can't scat today like I scatted then -- bee-bop, da-bee-bop, beep, boom, boom (Scats)...and all that jive. See you haven't the freedom of (inaudible) as I had then either, you know. It's a different story.
Scat singing, where did that come from -- scat singing?
Where did it come from?
Yeh.

First one I heard to do that, was Buck would do that -- rah-bee-bop, bee-bop-boom. Then it come back again -- I don't know, I've forgotten where I first heard that at. I thought Buck started that to my knowledge once but somebody else had started it before that but I've forgotten who it was. It couldn't have been Satchel Paige -- no, he's a ball player. I'll have to think about that.
Well, Louis Armstrong --
Louis Armstrong would scat, yeah.
But Buck was a good scat singer, was that part of your act?
I think Louis Armstrong was the first one I heard do that. I think it was Louis Armstrong, I'm not sure.
Did Buck scat within your own act?
If we'd do a
number we'd do a scat. We did a scat in "Rhythm for Sale." We'd take breaks in "Rhythm for Sale" like --
We've got rhythm for sale da-deek-dee-baba-da-baba-dee, etc. Yes we've got rhythm for sale.
Like that, harmony.
